## Goal
- Complete Phase 1 by obtaining a passing IVX E2E workflow and authenticated production evidence for zero Rork runtime dependencies.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Execute real end-to-end work only; never simulate, overstate, or fabricate evidence.
- Use owner-controlled infrastructure only; preserve authorization and never expose credentials.
- Required production parity:
  ```text
  GitHub main SHA = Render deployed SHA = /health SHA = /version SHA
  ```
- Return only exact Phase 1/E2E/independence/blocker status when responding to the user.
- IVX IA—not Rork—must execute later certification-task engineering work through its own worker/tools; Rork may supervise/audit.
- Certification still requires three real IVX IA engineering tasks and three persisted two-hour reports surviving worker restarts.
- Android APK remains direct-install/sideload; unrelated iOS template issues remain excluded.

## Progress
### Done
- Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0` was updated from `ivx-autonomous` to `main`:
  ```text
  PATCH /v1/services/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0 → HTTP 200
  repo https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  branch main
  autoDeploy yes
  ```
- Triggered a cache-clearing Render deploy:
  ```text
  POST /v1/services/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0/deploys
  body {"clearCache":"clear","commitId":"23b797ca148b19cbee3856d622daf26cc3b5ded8"}
  HTTP 202
  deployment dep-d9nltmqpbhcs73csgkc0
  ```
- `dep-d9nltmqpbhcs73csgkc0` reached `live`:
  ```text
  startedAt 2026-08-02T15:14:46.931424Z
  finishedAt 2026-08-02T15:16:04.670847Z
  commit 23b797ca148b19cbee3856d622daf26cc3b5ded8
  ```
- Re-verified production parity on prior `main`:
  ```text
  GitHub main = deployed commit = /health = /version
  23b797ca148b19cbee3856d622daf26cc3b5ded8
  ```
- Diagnosed failed `IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline` run:
  ```text
  workflow run 30752256882
  head_sha 23b797ca148b19cbee3856d622daf26cc3b5ded8
  failed job 91508248873: TypeScript typecheck
  ```
  ```text
  backend/generated/ivx-senior-developer-smoke-test.test.ts(3,1): error TS2593: Cannot find name 'test'.
  backend/generated/ivx-senior-developer-smoke-test.test.ts(4,3): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'expect'.
  ```
- Applied and committed the minimal root typecheck repair directly to GitHub `main`:
  ```text
  commit b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  fix(ci): exclude test sources from production root typecheck
  ```
  ```json
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.spec.ts"]
  ```
- Local validation passed before commit:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  ```
- Verified workflow source `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: downstream Playwright and Maestro jobs depend on root `typecheck`.
- Obtained an authorized emergency owner session without weakening endpoint authorization:
  ```text
  POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login → HTTP 200
  sessionMethod magiclink_token_hash
  passwordPreserved true
  ```
- Authenticated against production independence endpoint:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/independence/status
  Authorization: Bearer <owner-session-token>
  HTTP 200
  authenticatedRole owner
  ownerOnly true
  routeRegistered true
  ```
- Confirmed source-level Expo runtime configuration has no active Rork toolkit package:
  ```text
  expo/package.json
  "@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk": null
  ```
- Source search found `withRorkMetro`, `@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk`, and Rork environment markers only in independence-audit/cutover scripts, not active Expo runtime configuration.

### In Progress
- GitHub Actions run for the E2E repair:
  ```text
  workflow run 30754224917
  head_sha b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  status in_progress
  ```
- Determine final conclusion and job-level evidence for `30754224917`.
- Complete authenticated production dependency assessment and determine whether reported external dependencies are Rork runtime dependencies or broader ownership/infrastructure dependencies.
- Re-run Phase 1 certification only after E2E completion and final independence determination.

### Blocked
- Phase 1 cannot pass until `IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline` run `30754224917` completes with `conclusion: success`.
- Production independence endpoint reports nonzero remaining external dependency:
  ```text
  externalDependencyPercent 44
  ownerControlPercent 56
  targetRorkDependencyPercent 0
  ```
- Authenticated report lists unresolved dependencies:
  ```text
  git-remote — External-managed git remote still active — high — in_progress
  aws-rork1 — AWS credential identity is Rork1 — critical — blocked
  provider-readiness-credentials — high — in_progress
  provider-admin-ownership — critical — needs_owner_proof
  ```
- Zero Rork runtime dependency cannot yet be truthfully marked `VERIFIED` from the currently available production report because `aws-rork1` is explicitly unresolved and the full report must be inspected for service/file/reason detail.
- Three owner-approved engineering tasks and restart-safe two-hour reporting evidence have not been run.

## Key Decisions
- Treat the exact root TypeScript failure as repaired by excluding test/spec sources from the production compilation scope; tests remain runnable through Bun rather than root production typecheck.
- Do not claim E2E PASS from local typecheck success; wait for the affected GitHub workflow run `30754224917`.
- Preserve owner-only access for `/api/ivx/independence/status`; HTTP 401 was resolved through an authorized emergency recovery owner session.
- Do not equate removal of Expo Rork SDK/Metro config with production zero-dependency certification; use the authenticated production tracker and report unresolved infrastructure identities honestly.
- Treat prior Render/main parity as valid for SHA `23b797ca148b19cbee3856d622daf26cc3b5ded8`; re-check parity after `b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e` is deployed.

## Next Steps
1. Poll GitHub Actions run `30754224917` until completed; capture run ID, conclusion, and affected job evidence.
2. If it fails, inspect only its failed job/log and make the smallest necessary repair; if it passes, retain it as E2E evidence.
3. Retrieve and inspect the complete authenticated `/api/ivx/independence/status` report, including all remaining blocker fields and any runtime dependency evidence.
4. Classify every remaining Rork dependency with exact file, service, and reason; mark `VERIFIED` only if none exists.
5. Verify Render deploys commit `b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e`; repeat GitHub/Render/`/health`/`/version` SHA parity.
6. Re-run Phase 1 certification and report PASS only if E2E, authenticated independence, and required parity all pass.

## Critical Context
- Production service:
  ```text
  srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  https://dashboard.render.com/web/srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  https://ivx-holdings-platform.onrender.com
  ```
- Production API:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com
  ```
- Prior deployed/runtime GitHub `main` SHA:
  ```text
  23b797ca148b19cbee3856d622daf26cc3b5ded8
  IVX autonomous coder: 2026-08-02T14:30:29.991Z
  ```
- New GitHub `main` repair commit:
  ```text
  b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e
  fix(ci): exclude test sources from production root typecheck
  ```
- Current affected E2E workflow:
  ```text
  30754224917
  https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/runs/30754224917
  status in_progress
  ```
- Root `tsconfig.json` repair:
  ```json
  "include": ["backend/**/*.ts", "server.ts", "expo/shared/**/*.ts", "expo/constants/ivx-owner-ai.ts"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.spec.ts"]
  ```
- Authenticated production tracker confirms:
  ```text
  deploymentMarker ivx-independence-tracker-2026-05-09t1235z-owner-access-github-day2
  ownerCanSignIn true
  ownerDashboardAccessible true
  ownerVariablesAccessible true
  independenceTrackerAccessible true
  role owner
  kycStatus approved
  ```
- Passwordless recovery requires an allowlisted owner email plus:
  ```json
  {"emergency":"true"}
  ```
  or:
  ```json
  {"emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}
  ```
- Existing worker lifecycle remains insufficient for later certification:
  ```text
  QUEUED → RUNNING → PATCHING → TESTING → COMMITTING → DEPLOYING → VERIFYING → COMPLETED/FAILED
  ```
- Historical worker job `ivx-worker-17842a3e-7bec-4048-be2d-f1e382923b86` is not certification evidence.

## Relevant Files
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: E2E workflow; root typecheck gates Playwright and Maestro jobs.
- `tsconfig.json`: Root compilation scope; repaired in commit `b62e0f139ce88ea614e2d89726cbf3d6792bab2e` to exclude `*.test.ts` and `*.spec.ts`.
- `backend/generated/ivx-senior-developer-smoke-test.test.ts`: Exact generated test file that caused run `30752256882` root typecheck failure.
- `backend/api/ivx-independence-status.ts`: Owner-gated production Phase 1 independence report endpoint.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: `assertIVXOwnerOnly`, owner-only JSON, and CORS authorization behavior used by the independence endpoint.
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`: Emergency-only owner recovery login implementation.
- `backend/hono.ts`: Registers `/api/ivx/independence/status`, `/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login`, and worker routes.
- `backend/services/ivx-rork-independence.ts`: Rork-dependency inspection/removal logic requiring authorized runtime audit.
- `expo/package.json`: Verified to have no `@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk` dependency.
- `expo/scripts/ivx-independence-audit.mjs`: Source references to Rork identifiers are audit checks, not runtime configuration.
- `expo/scripts/rork-independence-cutover.mjs`: Cutover utility/documentation references Rork removal steps, not runtime configuration.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: Worker queue, lifecycle states, persistence/proof ledger, and recovery behavior for post-Phase-1 audit.
- `render.yaml`: Production blueprint declares `branch: main`.
- `backend/services/ivx-internal-deploy-auth.ts`: Internal signed deployment authorization module restored in `12644a4005a3582b45256324f4c53c6206ae40a5`.
